Wimpy, Whitten, Williams (2021) argue SLX specification faithfully reflects typical political science theories common SAR model, much easier estimate interpret: plain OLS augmented design matrix. slxr exists mechanics building W, multiplying right columns X, reporting direct/indirect/total effects cleanly friction applied researchers endure.

title: Getting started with slxr
text: package ships defense_burden, 1995 cross-section 179 countries drawn replication archive Wimpy, Whitten, Williams (2021). data include change military expenditures (outcome), lagged covariates, three row-standardized spatial weights matrices encoding different channels international connectivity. defense_burden$data tibble country-level observations. defense_burden$W_contig, $W_alliance, $W_defense sparse weights matrices connecting countries geographic contiguity, alliance ties, mutual defense pacts, respectively.
